en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a broad, tree-lined avenue running alongside a canal or waterway. Traditional sailboats are moored along the left bank, while large trees create a shaded promenade on the right where a few people can be seen walking. There is a red postage stamp with a monarch's profile in the upper-right corner. At the lower-left, printed text identifies the location as Ismailia and labels the scene as an avenue of acacias.
